user.title: Victron BT Devices
user.description: Choose the device or enter its MAC address.

settings.title: Victron BT Devices: PIN and key
settings.description: PIN of {name} (default 000000). The encryption key is optional and only needed to read the live values; find it in VictronConnect under product info, Instant Readout.

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be exactly 6 digits.
error.invalid_key: The key must be 32 hex characters.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported Victron device

data_description.scan_interval: How often the values are read, 10-600 s. The connection stays open either way.
data_description.pin: Change this only after changing the PIN on the device (VictronConnect). Used for the next pairing.
data_description.auto_reset: If BlueZ keeps the data channel of a dropped link ("Notify acquired"), clear its cache and pair again by itself.
data_description.auto_reset_minutes: Once a reset is done, the next automatic one waits at least this long.
data_description.unpair: One-time action: closes the connection and makes Home Assistant's Bluetooth forget the device and its bond. Afterwards press "Pair with PIN", or delete the entry.

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be exactly 6 digits.
error.unpair_failed: Removing the pairing failed, see the log.
